newsitem.title: MEXICO: Hewlett Packard says Mexico exports $450 mln in 96.
newsitem.headline: Hewlett Packard says Mexico exports $450 mln in 96.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard expects exports from its computer equipment plant in Mexico to rise between 15 percent and 20 percent to about $450 million in 1996 from the year before, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.

"In exports, I believe we are closing very well, in fact, the amount should be about $450 million, a growth of 15 to 20 percent (compared with 1995)," company official Jaime Reyes Robles told reporters.
Reyes Robles said domestic sales also improved in 1996, "perhaps about 25 percent above 1995."
In 1997, the company plans to invest about $10 million on project expansions, he said, without providing specific details.
Highway robberies caused the company to lose $2 million to $3 million in stolen goods in 1996, Reyes Robles said. Insurance premiums rose more than 100 percent because of the thefts.
